scope: caller-configurable identity/inf in implicit treap, dynamic Li Chao and 2D line container

implementation_review.default_inf: 2^60; Li Chao defaults to type maximum for narrower signed types
implementation_review.treap: Custom identity has shared immutable ownership; copy/move/clear/swap preserve the specified identity, including moved-from empty trees. Tests include values above the new default and indexed adjacent endpoints.
implementation_review.li_chao: Runtime sentinel is used for empty nodes/queries; old NTTP sentinel remains supported. Tests include sentinel intercept with negative slope, INT_MIN result, all signed widths and custom-setting preservation.
implementation_review.line2d: Truncation and rounding clamp before integer conversion; INT64_MAX and nextafter boundaries are checked. Floating evaluation is not asserted to be exact for arbitrary large integer inner products.

changes_by_validation_agent: Existing Line2D default saturation test now expects infinity()=2^60 instead of the legacy INTEGER_LIMIT constant.
Li Chao and Line2D allocation-failure tests additionally check custom-setting retention on failure/success.
Three Examples now demonstrate explicit custom inf/identity with their stdout unchanged.
Added custom_inf_test.cpp and unittest registration in Scripts/tests/test_custom_inf_runtime.py.

validation.instrumentation: ASan, UBSan, float-cast-overflow, LSan; GCC/Clang native+standard fallback, checked. LSan was executed ptrace-free after the normal runner reported an environment ptrace limitation.

performance.method: Isolated API workload, identical main/no input/output except final elapsed time and checksum; before/current default constructors, -std=c++23 -O2 -DSKIP_RUNTIME_CHECKS; CPU25; first warmup round excluded, 11 timed trials with alternating order. Treap uses its original time-seeded priorities, not a modified body. Default sentinel values differ but workload mathematical results/checksums agree.
performance.scope: Not a Library Checker submission-time claim or whole-program input/output comparison.
performance.decision: No added body changes justified. Approximately 1% differences in Treap/2D and GCC full-line tests are not claimed as stable changes. Clang Li Chao workload shows lower times here; this is not generalized to all workloads.
performance.superseded_screen: The first screen used a signed checksum in some builds and was discarded because the segment workload could overflow it; all final benchmark builds use uint64_t checksum. Its records are retained only as superseded evidence.

online_status: Not submitted online; old AC is not applied to changed source. Global generation and online/source review records are handled by the root task.
